description.en: The ID of the region where the cloud service is accessed.
The ID of the CEN instance.
The IP addresses or CIDR blocks of the cloud service.

description.zh:
云服务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口查询地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cloud service.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that is associated with the cloud service.
